messages:
olivia_support: Hey team — customer (acct: acct_7X) just opened an escalation. Their invoice shows ~3.2M tokens for Feb but their local SDK estimator consistently reports ~2.1M. They provided a few sample requests, asking why the ~1.1M delta. Can someone pick this up?

kevin_engineer: I can take a look. Do we have a sample request + X-Request-Id from the invoice timeframe?

olivia_support: They attached one. session_id=sh-8c9, X-Request-Id=rx-20260214-991. Repro curl below (redacted):
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"open-llm-4x","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are helpful."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize the report."}],"stream":true,"functions":[{"name":"lookup_db","parameters":{"id":"string"}}]}' \
  https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/chat/completions
```

kevin_engineer: Two immediate suspects: 1) server-injected prefill/system/tool tokens (we inject KV/cache metadata or prefills for some customers), 2) function/tool calls that generate hidden assistant messages or longer tool outputs that local estimator may not fetch.

alex_dev: Also check streaming boundary behavior: local estimator might stop counting when it sees client-side chunk end, while metering could count an extra "+EOS" or injected post-processing tokens.

kevin_engineer: Can you paste what their SDK estimator returned for that exact request? Small snippet (no creds) is fine.

olivia_support: They sent this snippet from node-sdk (estimator):
```
const est = estimateTokens(messages); // returns {prompt: 4500, completion: 1200, total: 5700}
console.log(est);
```
But the invoice per X-Request-Id shows total_tokens: 8700 for that request id.

kevin_engineer: That's useful. Differences: invoice 8700 vs SDK 5700 => ~3000 tokens unaccounted. Common drivers: a) server-side system/tool responses appended after completion (e.g., we synthesize a final assistant system message), b) tool outputs inserted into the final completion (could be large), c) downstream reranker/normalizer calls that were billed to the same request id.

alex_dev: @kevin_engineer can you check our meter logs for rx-20260214-991? I can grep for server-side injected messages pattern: "__rw_prefill" or "__internal_tool_output".

kevin_engineer: Pulling logs now. Quick grep: `grep rx-20260214-991 /var/log/redwood/metering/*.log` returns two entries: one at 2026-02-14T22:33:12 (initial chat start) and one at 2026-02-14T22:33:14 (post-process). The post-process entry shows an inserted assistant message coming from tool lookup_db with length ~2800 tokens. That would explain the delta.

olivia_support: So the tool call is being charged in invoice but the customer's SDK estimator didn't simulate the tool output (makes sense). Customer expected estimator to match invoice. How do we explain and fix?

kevin_engineer: Short answer: tool outputs and server-side synthesized messages are part of the billable token usage and are often not predicted by simple client-side estimators unless they run the exact tool/data locally. Ask the customer for use-case: are they expecting tool outputs to be free?

alex_dev: For reproducibility with the customer: provide a minimal curl that forces the tool to return a deterministic small payload (or disable functions) and ask them to rerun the SDK estimator against that controlled case. Example: set functions=[] and stream=false. If invoice still high, we have to audit pipeline for any hidden postprocessing (rerankers, eval hooks).

olivia_support: I told them: 1) we see server-side tool output ~2800 tokens for that request — that's the ~1.1M-monthly scale delta they see. 2) Repro steps to verify locally. 3) We'll open a billing audit to trace all requests for acct_7X in Feb.

sre-bot: Automated note: Billing audit ticket created #AUD-2026-138. Assigned to metering-team. Links: https://redwood-internal/tickets/AUD-2026-138

kevin_engineer: Action items: (a) metering-team to confirm all tool outputs for acct_7X were charged correctly, (b) devex to add doc blurb explaining function/tool output billing vs estimator assumptions, (c) support to give customer a breakdown by X-Request-Id and offer export of per-request deltas. I'll add meter log excerpts to ticket.

olivia_support: Thanks. One more small ask: can we add an SDK flag to optionally include server-side tool/assistant tokens in estimate (best-effort)? Customer asked for that feature.

alex_dev: Good product idea. I'll spin up a design note in eng-devex and drop a short RFC in #devex. For now, recommend customers run with functions disabled if they want estimator parity for billing.

olivia_support: Closing loop with customer now — will attach AUD-2026-138 and the sample log lines showing the tool output length. Will offer credit if metering-team finds a bug.

kevin_engineer: FYI for docs: common gaps to call out — server-injected prefill, tool outputs, streaming postprocessing, rerankers, and duplicate retries counted if they hit the runtime (include example grep commands and fields like X-Request-Id).

olivia_support: Thanks everyone :pray: — I'll update the ticket with customer confirmation tonight.
